title: Professional Services Projects Invoice Due Dates, Payment Application and Late Fees
content:
Professional Services Projects invoices fall due the class's net payment terms in calendar days after posting.

## Payment application

A payment is applied to the invoice its remittance names, otherwise to the oldest open invoice of the engagement first, one entry per invoice applied. Card payments are accepted only for an invoice whose total does not exceed the class card limit.

## Late fees

On the first day of each calendar month every invoice still unpaid more than the class grace period in calendar days after its due date is assessed one late fee of the class monthly late fee percentage of its unpaid balance, or the class minimum late fee if greater, rounded half up to the cent.

| Unpaid more than the grace period after the due date on the first day of the month? | Late fee that month |
|---|---|
| No | none |
| Yes | the higher of the monthly percentage of the unpaid balance and the minimum late fee, rounded half up to the cent |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures, monthly percentage 1.5 and minimum 25.00)

- An invoice with an unpaid balance of 1000.00: 1.5 percent is 15.00, below the minimum, so the late fee is 25.00.
- An invoice with an unpaid balance of 4000.00: 1.5 percent is 60.00, above the minimum, so the late fee is 60.00.
- An invoice of 12000.00 on an engagement whose card limit is 10000.00 may not be paid by card; one of 10000.00 may.
